title: What can this network reach?
why: Everything else depends on this. The asking box is 403 on samfw and fota-cloud and those two carry the ONLY patch levels in the corpus (39 of 1,207 devices). Confirm this IP is not blocked, and find out what else it unlocks.
control: example.com is fetched first and last; if it fails nothing else is a finding
deliver: probe.json + result.json, pushed automatically by relay.py run
expect: samfw.com and fota-cloud should be 'ok' here. They are 403 on the asking box. gsmarena and Qualcomm already work there, so those are regression controls.
